## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue is fixed or feature implemented.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactoring / Code quality improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Test cases / Security verification

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style and formatting standards of this project.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas, and added Javadocs.
- [ ] All new and existing unit and integration tests pass locally via `mvn clean verify`.
- [ ] Checkstyle and SpotBugs run without major/high violations.
- [ ] No secrets or credentials are hardcoded.
